sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Three layers, **always the same**:

- **Language** — types (incl. `BigInt`), `==` vs `===`, hoisting, scoping (`var` / `let` / `const`).
- **Runtime** — event loop + microtasks + macrotasks; `this` rules; closures.
- **Modern syntax** — destructuring, optional chaining, nullish coalescing, modules (`import` / `export`).

Senior signal: name **temporal dead zone**, **prototype chain**, and **tail-call** trivia confidently.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:

- **Variables scope and hoisting** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **`this` rules** — call site, arrow inherits, `bind` overrides.
- **Closures** — variables captured by reference; classic loop+`var` bug.
- **Promises** — micro-task queue, `await` is sugar over `.then`.
- **Equality** — always `===` unless you mean it; `null == undefined` is the only sane `==`.
- **Modules** — `import` is hoisted, evaluated once, supports tree-shaking when bundlers can prove side-effect-free.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd reach for <const + arrow function | class | module> because <reason rooted in scope / behaviour>; the runtime concern is <event-loop ordering | closure capture | this-binding>; the modern syntax I'd use is <optional chaining | destructuring | spread> for clarity."*
